task.title: Treat an empty alt attribute as decorative, not as a missing alt
task.body:
Why: packages/seo/docs/research/handoff-audit-unlighthouse-quality-2026-10-07.md:193 ("pusty alt może być prawidłowy"); packages/seo/src/domain/onsite.ts:41 counts `alt === ""` as missing; packages/seo/src/domain/rule-playbook.ts:85 already tells editors to set alt="" on decorative images.
Outcome: `analyzeOnsite(pages, options)` (src/domain/onsite.ts) counts an image toward rule `img-missing-alt` only when its `ImageFact.alt` is `null` (attribute absent). An image with `alt: ""` is decorative and is never counted. A page whose images all have `alt: ""` or a non-empty alt yields no `img-missing-alt` finding. When the finding is emitted, `evidence[0]` keeps the form `"<missing> z <total> obrazów bez alt."` where `<missing>` counts only `alt: null` images and `<total>` is all images on the page. All other image rules (`img-missing-dimensions`, `img-legacy-format`, `img-no-lazy`) are unchanged.
Proof: the implementer adds own tests in tests/domain/onsite.test.ts covering empty alt (no finding), null alt (finding) and the mixed-page evidence count.

spec: `analyzeOnsite(pages, options)` (src/domain/onsite.ts) counts an image toward rule `img-missing-alt` only when its `ImageFact.alt` is `null` (attribute absent). An image with `alt: ""` is decorative and is never counted. A page whose images all have `alt: ""` or a non-empty alt yields no `img-missing-alt` finding. When the finding is emitted, `evidence[0]` keeps the form `"<missing> z <total> obrazów bez alt."` where `<missing>` counts only `alt: null` images and `<total>` is all images on the page. All other image rules (`img-missing-dimensions`, `img-legacy-format`, `img-no-lazy`) are unchanged.
install: npm --prefix packages/seo ci --silent && npm --prefix packages/seo run build --silent
test: cd packages/seo && npx vitest run tests/hidden/hidden.test.ts
